title: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 464 (Prohibition of association or partnership exceeding certain number)

content.overview: No association or partnership of more than the prescribed number of persons shall be formed for a business that has gain as its object, unless it is registered as a company or formed under another law.
content.glance: No association or partnership of more than the prescribed number of persons shall be formed for a business that has gain as its object, unless it is registered as a company or formed under another law.
content.study: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 464 (Prohibition of association or partnership exceeding certain number). No association or partnership of more than the prescribed number of persons shall be formed for a business that has gain as its object, unless it is registered as a company or formed under another law. The section applies only to the persons, companies, and transactions it names. A filing, approval, or penalty arises only where the section or a rule under it says so. It does not create a power that is reserved to another section or to the Tribunal. Not a verified closure.

sections.heading: Rule
sections.body: No association or partnership of more than the prescribed number of persons shall be formed for a business that has gain as its object, unless it is registered as a company or formed under another law.

sections.heading: Explanation
sections.body: The ceiling is one hundred, subject to the rules. A Hindu undivided family carrying on business is outside the count. An association in breach is an illegal association, and the members are personally liable.
